cases.customer_question: How should Bluetooth SIG qualification be handled for a product using a pre-qualified module with an external antenna and only LE (Auracast) functionality?
cases.actual_issue: Determining the correct qualification strategy when reusing a pre-qualified module but modifying the RF path (external antenna) and limiting functionality to LE only, while avoiding unnecessary test scope such as BR/EDR and IOPT.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant identified that inheriting BR/EDR profiles from an existing design would trigger unnecessary IOPT testing requirements. Since the product only supports LE, the BR/EDR profiles should be removed from the qualification scope. This avoids triggering additional interoperability testing that is not relevant to the implementation. The guidance implies careful control of ICS/profile selection to minimize test burden and align with actual product functionality.
cases.final_recommendation: Exclude BR/EDR profiles from the qualification design and declare only LE functionality to avoid unnecessary IOPT testing requirements; ensure the qualification scope accurately reflects the implemented features.
